answer: Identity-bond decay: each agent stakes a copper bond losing 2% of its value every epoch unless topped up. Forging 1,000 fake identities means feeding 1,000 decaying bonds: $40 each, $40,000 locked, plus $800 per epoch in top-ups - a cost spiral growing with every fake. An honest agent pays $40 once and earns $10 per epoch in fees. A bought identity keeps decaying under its new owner, its ember fading, so rented reputation never pays off.
